examples.text: But garden experts warn — not too fast.
examples.translation: 但园艺专家提醒说：别急着动手。
examples.speechText: But garden experts warn — not too fast.

examples.text: For one thing, more than half of the people in the United States are not qualified（qualify的过去分词形式） to work.
examples.translation: 一方面，美国有一半以上的人不具备工作的资格。
examples.speechText: For one thing, more than half of the people in the United States are not qualified to work.

examples.text: By 1950 it had been taught to one and a half million people, and more than one hundred newspapers（newspaper的复数形式） and magazines in the language are published regularly throughout the world.
examples.translation: 到1950年，已有150万人学习过这门语言，全球有超过一百种报纸和杂志定期出版。
examples.speechText: By 1950 it had been taught to one and a half million people, and more than one hundred newspapers and magazines in the language are published regularly throughout the world.

examples.text: Offer to do something, finish a project or take the kids to their piano lessons.
examples.translation: 主动提出做点什么、完成一个项目，或者送孩子们去上钢琴课。
examples.speechText: Offer to do something, finish a project or take the kids to their piano lessons.

examples.text: Spend half of your time talking and the other half listening.
examples.translation: 把一半时间用于说话，另一半时间用于倾听。
examples.speechText: Spend half of your time talking and the other half listening.

examples.text: Only years later did I learn the truth about the matter.
examples.translation: 直到多年以后，我才知道这件事的真相。
examples.speechText: Only years later did I learn the truth about the matter.

examples.text: The couple have tried hard to save their troubled marriage for the sake of their children.
examples.translation: 这对夫妻为了孩子，一直努力挽救陷入困境的婚姻。
examples.speechText: The couple have tried hard to save their troubled marriage for the sake of their children.

examples.text: You’ll be late for school again!
examples.speechText: You’ll be late for school again!

examples.text: An influencer is a person who can influence the decisions of followers because of the relationship with the audience and his or her knowledge in a particular area.
examples.translation: 网络影响者是指这样的人：凭借与受众的关系以及在某一领域的知识，能够影响关注者的决定。
examples.speechText: An influencer is a person who can influence the decisions of followers because of the relationship with the audience and his or her knowledge in a particular area.

examples.text: Pinned（pin的过去分词形式） to their drawing boards are blueprints for improved quake-resistant buildings.
examples.translation: 被钉在他们绘图板上的是改进型抗震建筑的设计蓝图
examples.speechText: Pinned to their drawing boards are blueprints for improved quake-resistant buildings.

examples.text: They tracked（track的过去式） kids' physical activities by using monitors that measured things like how fast, long and intensely they moved.
examples.translation: 他们通过使用监测器来追踪孩子们的身体活动，这些监测器测量诸如他们移动得有多快、持续了多长时间以及活动得有多剧烈等数据。
examples.speechText: They tracked kids' physical activities by using monitors that measured things like how fast, long and intensely they moved.

examples.text: Therefore, when they look for jobs, they have few skills that they can offer.
examples.translation: 因此，他们找工作时，几乎没有什么拿得出手的技能。
examples.speechText: Therefore, when they look for jobs, they have few skills that they can offer.

examples.text: She was wearing skintight pedal pushers, a flashy, floppy top, and sneakers with no socks（sock的复数形式） bizarrely inappropriate even at our very informal company.
examples.translation: 她穿着紧身七分裤和花哨宽松的上衣，还没穿袜子就套上了运动鞋；即使在我们这家很不拘礼节的公司，这样的穿着也显得十分不得体。
examples.speechText: She was wearing skintight pedal pushers, a flashy, floppy top, and sneakers with no socks bizarrely inappropriate even at our very informal company.

examples.text: And it is true that the sea has a great capacity for absorbing（absorb的-ing形式） organic wastes.
examples.translation: 而且，海洋确实具有很强的吸收有机废弃物的能力。
examples.speechText: And it is true that the sea has a great capacity for absorbing organic wastes.

examples.text: It didn’t even matter that it was cold and had no bathroom.
examples.translation: 甚至连住处寒冷、没有浴室也无所谓。
examples.speechText: It didn’t even matter that it was cold and had no bathroom.
